rank_math_description: North Carolina small claims in 2026: $10,000 limit, flat $96 fee, trial within 30 days before a magistrate, 10-day appeal for a new trial and 8% interest.
pdf_outline: Checklist: demand letter -> defendant's county -> complaint marked 'Small Claim' -> magistrate summons -> $96 + service -> service (G.S. 7A-217) -> trial within 30 days (bring witnesses; rules of evidence apply) -> 10-day notice of appeal + 20-day appeal costs -> execution / lien
